[[Navbahor Namangan]] remained for the 2017 Uzbek League after winning in the relegation play-off match with ''Naryn''. [[FK Obod Tashkent|Obod Tashkent]] was promoted to the 2016 League as the 2015 First League winner. The draw for the 2016 season was held on 20 December 2016.
